This is particularly relevant for the patient as she will need ongoing support and information during her follow-up care.

The ASCO survivor and caregiver site offers valuable resources for cancer survivors and their caregivers, including guidelines on managing long-term and late effects of cancer treatment. This is important for the patient as she plans to undergo adjuvant chemotherapy and hormonal therapy.

The NCCN patient and caregiver resources provide detailed guidelines and support for cancer survivors, which can help the patient navigate her post-treatment care and manage any side effects or health concerns.

Journey Forward offers tools for creating a survivorship care plan, which can help the patient and her healthcare team manage her follow-up care effectively. This is particularly useful as she transitions from active treatment to survivorship.

The CA Patient Page helps patients understand how to use guidelines to talk to their doctor about surveillance, screening, symptom management, and healthy behaviors. This can empower the patient to take an active role in her follow-up care.
